title: Apple (AAPL) PT Lowered to $180.00 at Bank of America
text:
Posted by Jim Brewer on Jan 30th, 2019 // No Comments
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target lowered by Bank of America from $190.00 to $180.00 in a report released on Wednesday. The brokerage presently has a “neutral” rating on the iPhone maker’s stock. Bank of America ‘s price target points to a potential upside of 11.53% from the stock’s current price.
Several other research analysts also recently issued reports on AAPL. Wedbush upgraded shares of Apple to an “outperform” rating and dropped their price objective for the stock from $310.00 to $275.00 in a report on Wednesday, November 28th. They noted that the move was a valuation call. Morgan Stanley upped their price objective on shares of Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the stock an “overweight” rating in a research note on Thursday, November 8th. JPMorgan Chase & Co. set a $272.00 target price on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, October 29th. UBS Group reduced their target price on shares of Apple from to and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research report on Monday, November 12th. Finally, Citigroup dropped their target price on shares of Apple from $240.00 to $200.00 and set a “buy” rating on the stock in a research report on Monday, December 10th. Three analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have assigned a hold rating and twenty-two have issued a buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $193.03. Get Apple alerts:
NASDAQ AAPL traded up $6.71 on Wednesday, hitting $161.39. 16,365,194 shares of the stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 34,227,660. Apple has a 52-week low of $142.00 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. The stock has a market cap of $768.24 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 13.55, a PEG ratio of 1.51 and a beta of 1.23. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Tuesday, January 29th. The iPhone maker reported $4.18 EPS for the quarter, beating the consensus estimate of $4.17 by $0.01. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The business had revenue of $84.31 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $84.07 billion. On average, research analysts forecast that Apple will post 11.89 EPS for the current fiscal year.
In related news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the firm’s stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 19th. The stock was sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which can be accessed through this hyperlink . 0.05% of the stock is owned by company insiders.

First National Bank of Omaha now owns 271,113 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $49,481,000 after purchasing an additional 6,766 shares during the period. Chesley Taft & Associates LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 1.3% in the second quarter. Chesley Taft & Associates LLC now owns 122,335 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $22,645,000 after purchasing an additional 1,515 shares during the period. Miller Green Financial Services Inc. ADV acquired a new stake in Apple in the second quarter valued at approximately $879,000. RDL Financial Inc. grew its holdings in Apple by 3.5% in the second quarter. RDL Financial Inc. now owns 20,679 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $3,828,000 after purchasing an additional 698 shares during the period. Finally, Covenant Asset Management LLC grew its holdings in Apple by 18.9% in the second quarter. Covenant Asset Management LLC now owns 38,802 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $7,183,000 after purchasing an additional 6,158 shares during the period. 57.02% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors.
About Apple
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
